newsitem.title: JAPAN: Showa Denko shares extend gains on earnings result.
newsitem.headline: Showa Denko shares extend gains on earnings result.

text.p: Shares in Showa Denko KK, a major Japanese chemical maker, extended their gains on Wednesday, drawing further support from a rise in the firm"s annual profits announced earlier this week, brokers said.
As of 0147 GMT, the shares were up eight yen at 266 with turnover at 3.62 million, the second-heaviest volume on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

On Monday, Showa Denko unveiled a parent current profit of 13.52 billion yen in calendar 1996, up from a 12.88 billion yen profit the previous year. Showa Denko also said on Monday it expected its parent current profit to grow to 15 billion yen and its net profit to 10 billion yen in 1997.
On Tuesday, the company said it would raise its stake in Showa Aluminum Corp to just over 50 percent, which it said would "significantly" boost group sales and current profits for calendar 1997.
Showa Denko shares had also risen on Tuesday on the prospects for higher earnings.
